name: Lyric glass
description: Turns the lyric line into a slab of molten glass laid over the scene: the frame refracts through the letter shapes with chromatic fringing, a rim lights their edges, and heat shimmers off them in rings. It does not draw the text itself — the lyric pass still does that on top — so the words stay readable and gain a body. With no line on screen it passes the frame through untouched.

refract.description: How hard the scene bends through the glyph edges.

spread.description: Radius of the thickness field, in fractions of the frame — how far the glass extends past the letters.

shimmer.description: Concentric heat ripple radiating off the letters.

cue.description: 0..1 through the current line's lifetime; the glass swells as the line lands.
